# Progress Steps

Data-driven stepper that shows where a record is in a process (for example an approval or order workflow). One row per step.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_PROGRESS_STEPS` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/progressSteps` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |

Each query row is one step. Map Status to a column returning complete, current, upcoming or error. Steps are numbered automatically and the current step is announced to screen readers.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Step name, for example Manager Approval. |
| `description` | Description | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional secondary text such as a date or the responsible person. |
| `status` | Status | sessionStateValue | yes |  | One of complete, current, upcoming or error. Unknown values render as upcoming. |
| `orientation` | Orientation | selectList (`horizontal`, `vertical`) | yes | `horizontal` | Horizontal steps switch to vertical automatically on narrow screens. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/progress-steps/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_progress_steps.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
